mini_games_integration.philosophy: Mini-games must be embedded seamlessly into the dark command-center aesthetic without losing their high-fidelity state logic.

roulette.container_theme: Obsidian backdrop, deep crimson & golden wheel highlights, sleek neon bet buttons, chip selector with glowing halo
roulette.controls: Schnellwette 10, 50, 100, 500, Max; Farb- & Zahlenwetten; Spin-Button mit Haptik-Animation

blackjack.container_theme: Felt dark emerald table surface #0D2818 with gold foil borders, crisp card flip animations, score counters with status glow
blackjack.controls: Austeilen (Deal), Karte (Hit), Halten (Stand), Verdoppeln (Double), Neuer Tisch

live_bets_table_spec.simulation: Automatischer sanfter Ticker fügt alle 3.5 Sekunden realistische Community-Wins ein

deposit_bonus_modal_spec.trigger: Topbar '+ Einzahlen' Button & Banner 'Bonus Einlösen' CTA
features: Sofort-Gutschrift Simulation: 100% Willkommensbonus bis zu 1.000 € + 200 Freispiele
Krypto- & Sofort-Methoden Icons (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, Apple Pay, Visa, Sofort)

motion_and_interactions.lenis_scrolling: Smooth momentum scrolling enabled with Lerp 0.08
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: transform: translateY(-4px), transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease
motion_and_interactions.glowing_borders: Subtle radiant borders on hover matching category accent colors
motion_and_interactions.live_indicator: CSS pulse animation for 'LIVE' red dots and 'ONLINE' green indicators
motion_and_interactions.chat_stagger: AnimatePresence initial: { opacity: 0, y: 10 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, exit: { opacity: 0 }

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.color_discipline: NO muddy washed-out gray. Use Deep Obsidian (#0A0C10) as body background and rich Dark Navy (#0E1015 / #151821) for cards. High contrast text (#FFFFFF, #94A3B8).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.cta_contrast: Deposit and key action buttons must use vibrant emerald green (#00E575) with crisp hover effects and high readability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.layout_integrity: The 3-column system must adapt smoothly: on desktop full 3-column with left icon bar and right chat; on tablet right chat collapses into toggleable sidebar; on mobile responsive single-column feed with bottom nav.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.state_management: Ensure Roulette and Blackjack balance syncs with the Topbar balance so winning in mini-games updates the top counter with animation.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_readiness: Every button, input, tab, card, and modal MUST contain semantic data-testid tags.
